identities.label: Calusa
identities.description: Native American people who lived on the coast and along the inner waterways of Florida's southwest coast
identities.summary:
The Calusa ( kə-LOO-sə, Calusa: *ka(ra)luś(i)) were a Native American people of Florida's southwest coast. Calusa society developed from that of archaic peoples of the Everglades region. Previous Indigenous cultures had lived in the area for thousands of years.
At the time of European contact in the 16th and 17th centuries, the historic Calusa were the people of the Caloosahatchee culture.
